meta.purpose: Public tool input contracts for offline CLI help and request validation.
meta.consumer: Select a tool by name and construct JSON arguments using the declared fields and constraints.
meta.scope: Supported tools and documented placeholders in this public specification.
meta.maintenance: Keep the public tool inventory, input constraints and descriptions consistent with supported behavior.

tool_entry_keys.conditional_required: 人类可读条件（如 platform_name or exchange_slug）；CLI 宜提示而非硬编码
tool_entry_keys.fields: 入参清单；type 为 JSON 类型；enum 为服务端会拒绝的闭集；enum_note/common_values 补充默认与别名
tool_entry_keys.logic: Public behavior, error conditions and data completeness notes
tool_entry_keys.description: English one-liner for agents and leaf -h ([Read] routing); embedded in gate-cli release binary only.

field_type_notes.string|string[]: A comma-separated string or an array of strings, as supported by the declared parameter contract.
field_type_notes.object: JSON object passed as the declared parameter value.

meta.enum_note: Declared enums describe accepted values. Empty values use the documented default.
meta.items_enum_note: string[] 的 items_enum 表示元素级闭集（若服务端校验）。
meta.common_values_note: Common values are examples rather than an exhaustive accepted set.
meta.placeholder_note: Placeholder tools report not_implemented and are not runnable CLI leaves.
meta.response_note: Tool entries document public response fields where available.

fields.name: query_type
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to auto

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to basic

tools.logic: Look up a non-empty query (maximum 512 characters) using query_type auto|address|symbol|name|project|gate_symbol|source_id (default auto) and scope basic|detailed|full|with_project|with_tokenomics (default basic). size defaults to 3, maximum 20. chain may disambiguate address/auto lookups. scope and fields select returned information. Invalid query/type/scope returns the documented error.
tools.description: [Read] Look up one coin or project by query (symbol, name, address, etc.). Filtered asset lists -> search_coins; leaderboards -> get_coin_rankings.

fields.name: asset_type
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to crypto

fields.name: sort_by
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to market_cap ordering

tools.logic: Filter assets by category, normalized chain, market-cap bounds and asset_type crypto|tradefi|all (default crypto). sort_by is market_cap|fdv|circulating_supply (default market_cap). Unknown categories return empty items. offset must be non-negative; limit defaults to 20 and is capped by the service maximum. Duplicate asset symbols are consolidated and total describes the matching assets.
tools.description: [Read] Search coins by filters (category, chain, market cap, asset type). Single-asset detail -> get_coin_info.

fields.name: limit
fields.enum_note: default 20; maximum 400

fields.name: time_range
fields.enum_note: only for top_gainers|top_losers (default 24h); must omit for other ranking_type or invalid_param

tools.logic: Select the ranking with ranking_type. top_gainers/top_losers support time_range 1h|24h|7d; time_range is rejected for other rankings. listing_* filters are accepted only for new_listing. market_pulse_hot uses the latest available heat ranking and returns not_implemented when unavailable. Preserve all declared ranking types and request bounds.
tools.description: [Read] Coin leaderboards (popular, gainers/losers, Twitter hot, airdrop, new listing, market pulse hot). Single coin -> get_coin_info.

fields.name: period
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to 24h; all disables time window filter

tools.logic: Return candlesticks for the required symbol and timeframe 1m|5m|15m|1h|4h|1d. period defaults to 24h; all disables that time filter. limit overrides size, default 100, subject to the service maximum. with_indicators explicitly includes technical indicators. Empty primary results may use an available alternate source; primary errors do not trigger that fallback. Item times are exposed as timestamp.
tools.description: [Read] OHLCV kline for a symbol with optional bundled indicators. Historical indicator series -> get_indicator_history; TA summary -> get_technical_analysis.

fields.name: indicators
fields.enum_note: A non-empty list of indicator names is required. Indicator names are not restricted to a fixed enum.

tools.logic: Return timestamp and the requested indicator values, newest first. indicators must contain at least one non-empty distinct name. timeframe is required and accepts 15m|1h|4h|1d. limit defaults to 50, subject to the service maximum. This operation does not fall back to plain candlestick data. Preserve symbol_empty, indicators_empty, invalid_timeframe and the declared query-failure error.
tools.description: [Read] Historical technical indicator values for a symbol/timeframe. Kline candles -> get_kline; narrative TA -> get_technical_analysis.

fields.name: period
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to 3d when no start/end; all disables time filter

tools.logic: Analyze 15m/1h/4h/1d technical signals. Absolute start/end times override period; when neither is given the default is 3d, while all disables the time filter. Include RSI/MACD/moving-average alignment, support/resistance and other documented indicators. Aggregate bullish|bearish|neutral across timeframes. A failed timeframe fails the operation rather than returning a complete-looking partial analysis.
tools.description: [Read] Aggregated technical-analysis signal across 15m/1h/4h/1d. Raw klines -> get_kline; per-indicator history -> get_indicator_history.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.enum_note: merged with indicator_timeframe; both omit -> 1h

fields.name: indicator_timeframe
fields.enum_note: alias when timeframe empty

fields.name: source
fields.enum_note: futures accepted as alias of future; omit -> spot; normalized to alpha|spot|future|fx

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit -> basic; scope=full merges Coinglass derivatives + institutional_channel_summary + market_pulse; scope=detailed 不再返回 derivatives（与 basic 行为一致）

tools.logic: Return the selected market snapshot. scope=full adds derivatives (funding_rate, open_interest, long_short_ratio), institutional_channel_summary for BTC/ETH when available, and market_pulse. basic/detailed omit derivatives. Return snapshot_not_configured when the snapshot capability is unavailable.
tools.description: [Read] Single-pair market snapshot (price, kline, optional Coinglass derivatives). Batch symbols -> batch_market_snapshot; macro venue flow -> get_institutional_metrics.

fields.name: timeframe
fields.enum_note: omit -> 1h

fields.name: source
fields.enum_note: futures alias of future; omit -> spot

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit -> basic; scope=full adds derivatives per symbol when available; scope=detailed does not return derivatives

tools.logic: Validate at most 20 symbols and the declared timeframe/scope/source. Return per-symbol snapshots with real-time and project information. scope=full adds derivatives for each symbol; basic/detailed omit them. Missing derivatives remain an empty object for that symbol rather than removing the symbol.
tools.description: [Read] Batch market snapshots for up to 20 symbols. One symbol -> get_market_snapshot.

tools.logic: Return aggregate market statistics, project context and BTC price using the available market data. Results may combine supported data sources when a complete overview is not available from one source.
tools.description: [Read] Global/crypto market overview (breadth, BTC context, aggregate stats). Per-symbol snapshot -> get_market_snapshot.

fields.name: asset
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive after trim; omit -> BTC; all returns BTC and ETH groups; invalid -> invalid_param

fields.name: start_date
fields.enum_note: YYYY-MM-DD; omit -> end_date - 30d when end_date/latest exists; invalid date -> invalid_param

fields.name: end_date
fields.enum_note: YYYY-MM-DD; omit -> latest available data date; invalid date -> invalid_param

fields.name: channel
fields.enum_note: Case-insensitive after trimming; omit -> all. A channel-specific response nulls unrelated metrics and recomputes each point data_status. CME metrics are unavailable, so channel=cme returns cme_* fields as null with cme_source_not_procured/cme_unavailable status.

fields.name: limit
fields.enum_note: default 30; valid range 1..366; invalid -> invalid_param

tools.logic: Normalize asset BTC|ETH|all, channel all|etf|cme|cftc and YYYY-MM-DD dates; reject start_date after end_date. With no end_date use the newest available date. asset=all returns BTC and ETH separately. Echo requested filters, aggregate total/count and data_status, and set latest to the first series point. Unavailable CME metrics remain null with cme_source_not_procured/cme_unavailable; ETF and CFTC values remain available. A channel-specific query nulls unrelated metrics. Empty data returns missing with assets=[]. Unavailable capability returns snapshot_not_configured.
tools.description: [Read] ETF/CFTC institutional channel time series (BTC/ETH); CME fields are null (no procured CME bulletin). Retail pair snapshot -> get_market_snapshot; not CEX orderbook depth.

fields.name: chain
fields.enum_note: aliases: eth, op→optimism, avax|avalanche-c→avalanche, bera|berachain→bera, polygon|matic, zksync, blast, gatelayer, linea, unichain, btc|bitcoin, sol|solana, trx|tron; unknown slug → invalid_chain

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: detailed maps to full; unknown values normalize to basic

fields.name: upstream_raw_mode
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive; unknown -> off; include_upstream_raw=true forces full

tools.logic: Return asset_summary, token_balances sorted by value_usd and multi_chain_token_balances sorted by usd_value. Preserve the documented Solana account/value fields. A failed supplementary balance source can return an empty supplementary list; an upstream-not-ready error fails the whole operation only when no presentable fields remain, otherwise report asset_summary_upstream_not_ready. exist_address=false clears both token lists. Supported EVM chains use the same EVM address validation.

errors.when: chain slug cannot be normalized (e.g. random chain name)
address format invalid for resolved chain
The requested chain is unsupported, or its configured data service is not ready and returns 404/501.

tools.description: [Read] On-chain address profile (balances, tokens, optional DeFi/PnL scope). Transfers list -> get_address_transactions; tx by hash -> get_transaction.

fields.name: chain
fields.enum_note: same aliases as get_address_info; BTC uses bitcoin/btc slug

fields.name: tx_type
fields.enum_note: omit -> all

fields.name: time_range
fields.enum_note: ignored when start_time or end_time set; 1d same window as 24h

fields.name: upstream_raw_mode
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive; unknown -> off; include_upstream_raw=true forces full

tools.logic: Return transactions with the documented inputs/outputs/status mapping and tx_type filtering. partial_upstream_response is reported when the source claims a positive total but supplies an empty or unparseable transaction list, before client time/value/type filtering. An unparseable positive-total response fails the CLI with empty stdout.

errors.when: address format invalid for resolved chain
upstream reports total>0 but transaction list cannot be parsed (e.g. BTC partial body)
The selected chain data is not ready or the chain is unsupported.

tools.description: [Read] Paginated transfers for an address with filters. Address summary -> get_address_info; single tx -> get_transaction.

fields.name: upstream_raw_mode
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive; unknown -> off; include_upstream_raw=true forces full

tools.logic: Require tx_hash up to 128 characters and a supported optional chain. Return transaction data with data_quality and sources; unavailable supplementary data can remain a sparse placeholder. include_upstream_raw=true forces full raw data. Otherwise upstream_raw_mode off|lite|full controls retained raw sections according to the public response contract.
tools.description: [Read] Single transaction detail by tx_hash. Address activity -> get_address_transactions.

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: unknown -> full

fields.name: upstream_raw_mode
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive; unknown -> off; include_upstream_raw=true forces full

tools.logic: Return token sections selected by scope holders|activity|transfers|smart_money|full; unknown scope normalizes to full. smart_money remains a placeholder when requested. Unavailable supplementary sources return empty section placeholders. upstream_raw_mode controls the documented raw-source sections and row source_raw fields.
tools.description: [Read] Token on-chain metrics (holders, activity, transfers; scope=smart_money is token analytics, not get_smart_money placeholder). Address/token security -> compliance tools.

conditional_required: token xor address (one required, not both)

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: non-full treated like basic for extended sections

fields.name: lang
fields.enum_note: omit -> en

tools.logic: Require chain and exactly one of token or address. A token symbol is resolved to its contract before analysis. scope basic|full (default basic) controls the risk lists, tax analysis and top holders. lang accepts en|cn|tw|ja|kr (default en). Unavailable security data returns the declared data_api_not_configured/data_api_risk_infos_failed errors; retain token_security_param for invalid inputs.
tools.description: [Read] Token contract security check; require chain and exactly one of token or address. Not address-risk placeholder check_address_risk.

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit or unknown -> basic; detailed maps to with_chain_breakdown

fields.name: include_oi_symbol_detail
fields.enum_note: scope=full only; true adds competition_metrics.oi_symbol_detail[] sorted by OI USD descending when CEX competition data is available; default false

fields.name: oi_symbol_limit
fields.enum_note: only when include_oi_symbol_detail=true; omit or <=0 uses default 20; values >100 return invalid_param

tools.logic: Resolve platform_id or platform_name to current platform data. scope=full adds history, up to five top yield pools, derivatives/period metrics and available CEX competition metrics. include_oi_symbol_detail selects oi_symbol_detail, capped by oi_symbol_limit. basic and with_chain_breakdown return their documented subset. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] DeFi/CEX platform profile (TVL, volume, fees; scope=full enriches history/pools). OI symbol detail only when scope=full. Platform list -> search_platforms.

fields.name: platform_type
fields.enum_note: No closed enum validation. Empty/all means no filter; unknown values are passed through as platform_type filters.

fields.name: sort_by
fields.enum_note: omit or other -> tvl sort field

fields.name: sort_order
fields.enum_note: omit or non-asc -> desc

tools.logic: Search platforms with platform_type normalization: empty/all means no type filter; dex|dexs|dexes selects DEX; cex and defi select their respective groups. Unknown type strings are passed through as filters. sort_order normalizes to asc|desc, default desc. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Rank/filter DeFi or CEX platforms. One platform detail -> get_platform_info.

fields.name: category
fields.enum_note: omit -> all; primary values match jsonschema_description; de-fi/cex/dex/dexs/dexes/lending/cdp/yield/derivatives are alias-expanded by normalizeDefiOverviewCategory; unknown strings are passed through as platform_type filter (no hard reject)

tools.logic: Return DeFi overview metrics and, when available, CEX perpetual-volume metrics and total USDT exchange reserves. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] DeFi ecosystem overview aggregates by category. Stablecoin supply/usage detail -> get_stablecoin_info.

fields.name: symbol
fields.enum_note: Basic stablecoin items: any symbol or omit for a ranked list. sections=issuance_flow allows USDT|USDC (omit defaults USDT+USDC); sections=usage_structure allows USDT|USDC|DAI|FDUSD|PYUSD (omit defaults all five). sections=depeg_events filters by asset symbol (case-insensitive, normalized to uppercase; omit = all assets). Unsupported extension symbol -> unsupported_stablecoin_symbol.

fields.name: chain
fields.enum_note: Basic: empty/all means no chain filter; single-chain filters by chain_circulating keys. Extension sections: all (default) or ethereum|omni|tron|solana|bsc|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|avalanche; aliases include eth/sol/bnb/arb/op/matic/avax; invalid extension chain -> invalid_chain

fields.name: limit
fields.enum_note: default 10 max 400; single row when symbol set

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: default basic; invalid scope -> invalid_param

fields.name: sections
fields.enum_note: Comma string or array; requires scope=full (else sections_requires_full_scope); can request one or more sections; unknown section -> invalid_sections

fields.name: start_date
fields.enum_note: UTC YYYY-MM-DD; only with scope=full and sections set else invalid_param; issuance_flow/usage_structure: default last 30 calendar days inclusive; depeg_events: default 2020-01-01 to today

fields.name: end_date
fields.enum_note: UTC YYYY-MM-DD; issuance_flow caps future dates to today; usage_structure defaults to latest data date when omitted; depeg_events defaults to today; window >366d truncates start with range_truncated=true

fields.name: min_deviation
fields.enum_note: depeg_events only: filter rows where max_deviation >= this value; range 0.001-0.2, default 0.005

fields.name: review_status
fields.enum_note: depeg_events only: filter by review_status; default approved; invalid value -> invalid_review_status

tools.logic: Validate scope basic|full and extension sections issuance_flow|usage_structure|depeg_events. Sections require full; extension date filters require extension sections. Rank base items by total_circulating descending. Preserve chain-specific list/detail behavior and top-five plus other-chain totals. issuance_flow adds flows and summary/series/chain_breakdown for chain=all; unavailable flow data returns placeholders with quality_note. usage_structure returns the declared window and metrics, preferring entity-adjusted transfer values and deriving bot_share when possible; missing values retain data_status/missing_fields/row_count. depeg_events normalizes symbols, defaults review_status to approved and min_deviation to 0.005, and sorts by deviation or date. range_truncated marks a clipped extension window. Unavailable base data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Stablecoin circulation and chain breakdown; scope=full + sections issuance_flow|usage_structure|depeg_events for supply, usage, and depeg analytics. DeFi category overview -> get_defi_overview.

fields.name: sort_by
fields.enum_note: omit -> volume_24h

tools.logic: Return bridge metrics sorted by volume_24h|volume_7d|volume_30d|deposit_txs_24h; unknown sort_by uses volume_24h. limit defaults to 10, maximum 400. bridge_name is normalized to lowercase. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Cross-chain bridge volume/TVL metrics. Platform-level metrics -> get_platform_info.

fields.name: market_type
fields.enum_note: case-insensitive; omit -> PERP; spot -> SPOT; unrecognized values are uppercased and passed through

fields.name: data_scope
fields.enum_note: When omitted: exchange if exchange is set and exchange-level data is available; otherwise market if market-level data is available; otherwise exchange. Invalid value -> invalid_param; unavailable selected data view -> not_implemented.

tools.logic: Require symbol and return CEX order-book-depth metrics. limit defaults to 20, maximum 100. An unavailable requested data view returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Aggregated CEX order-book depth from indices (multi-exchange); not Gate live book -> marketdetail get_orderbook.

fields.name: sort_by
fields.enum_note: only tvl_usd switches sort key; omit or any other value -> apy sort

fields.name: min_tvl_usd
fields.enum_note: omit -> default floor 100000 USD; 0 = no TVL floor

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit -> basic; full adds apy_base_30d, apy_reward_30d, reward_tokens, market_share per pool

tools.logic: Filter yield pools by project, normalized chain aliases, symbol and pool_type; consolidate duplicate pool observations before sorting. sort defaults to apy descending and also supports tvl_usd. limit defaults to 20, maximum 400. basic returns the documented subset. Unavailable data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] DeFi yield pool rankings (APY/TVL filters; scope=full adds 30d APY and reward fields). Platform context -> get_platform_info.

conditional_required: platform_name or exchange_slug (at least one required)

fields.name: metrics
fields.enum_note: omit or empty -> [tvl]; individual metric names are not restricted to a fixed enum

fields.name: granularity
fields.enum_note: omit or unknown -> day; selects the time granularity of volume_perps history

tools.logic: Require platform_name or exchange_slug. metrics defaults to [tvl]; granularity defaults to day. volume_perps returns derivative-volume history at the selected granularity. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Historical TVL/volume/fees (or perps volume) for a platform_name or exchange_slug (at least one required). Snapshot -> get_platform_info.

fields.name: exchange
fields.enum_note: empty -> all-exchange rollup; non-empty matches the supplied exchange name and its normalized aliases

fields.name: asset
fields.enum_note: omit defaults to BTC; other values -> invalid_param

fields.name: scope
fields.enum_note: omit -> basic; full adds por when available and optionally flows/events; invalid scope -> invalid_param

fields.name: include_history
fields.enum_note: default false; true only with scope=full else invalid_param; attaches precomputed PoR comparison fields, not raw snapshots

fields.name: history_window
fields.enum_note: only when include_history=true; omit defaults to quarter; other values -> invalid_param

fields.name: include_flows
fields.enum_note: scope=full only; true returns flows.series[] with daily inflow/outflow/netflow in native units and USD. Unavailable flow data -> not_implemented. Omitted defaults to false.

fields.name: include_events
fields.enum_note: scope=full only; true returns events[] for large flows with threshold/rolling_30d_std fields; requires available flow-event data; omitted defaults to false

fields.name: start_date
fields.enum_note: YYYY-MM-DD; only when include_flows=true or include_events=true; omit defaults to end_date - 30d; invalid date -> invalid_param

fields.name: end_date
fields.enum_note: YYYY-MM-DD; only when include_flows=true or include_events=true; omit defaults to today; invalid date -> invalid_param

fields.name: event_type
fields.enum_note: only when include_events=true; all returns all events (large_flow_event=true+false); large_flow filters large_flow_event=true only; omit defaults to all

fields.name: limit
fields.enum_note: only when include_flows=true or include_events=true; max flow rows; default 100, max 400

tools.logic: Return latest exchange reserves, with asset default BTC. scope=full optionally adds proof-of-reserves, flows and events when supported. include_flows returns daily native/USD inflow, outflow and netflow in flows.series. include_events returns the documented large-flow events and threshold/statistical fields. Unavailable required data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Exchange reserve balances (optional asset filter); scope=full for PoR, flows (daily netflow), and large-flow events. Not stablecoin chain breakdown -> get_stablecoin_info.

fields.name: exchange
fields.enum_note: omit = all exchanges; non-empty matches the exchange name and its normalized aliases

fields.name: range
fields.enum_note: optional price bucket filter, format min-max e.g. 40000-50000; parse fail = no range filter (not invalid_param)

tools.logic: Require symbol and return the latest liquidation heatmap. An omitted exchange filter includes all exchanges; aliases are normalized. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Futures liquidation heatmap by symbol (and optional exchange/range). Order book depth -> get_cex_orderbook_depth or marketdetail get_orderbook.

fields.name: metric_group
fields.enum_note: phase-1 supported groups; staking=Ethereum beacon daily, l2=L2 ops daily (growthepie+L2Beat), btc_l2=BTC L2 protocol ecosystem; other values -> not_implemented

fields.name: chain
fields.enum_note: staking: only eth|ethereum allowed (others -> unsupported_chain); l2: supports base/arbitrum/optimism/linea/zksync_era/blast or empty for all chains; btc_l2: empty defaults to btc (only btc allowed)

fields.name: project
fields.enum_note: btc_l2 only: filter by project_key; empty returns whitelist (stacks|rootstock|merlin|bob|bitlayer). Non-whitelist project returns data_status=not_in_scope

fields.name: start_date
fields.enum_note: UTC YYYY-MM-DD. Together with end_date, defines an inclusive date window. With start_date only, include points from that date through the newest available point. A span >400d or a start-only request beyond the cap sets range_truncated=true and adjusts start_date to the effective oldest returned date. Future dates are capped to today with start_date_capped.

fields.name: end_date
fields.enum_note: UTC YYYY-MM-DD; with start_date defines window; omit with start empty and end set -> end anchors lookback window; omit with start only -> derived from newest hit; both dates empty -> ignored (uses lookback-only path); future capped to today with end_date_capped

fields.name: lookback
fields.enum_note: when start_date empty: default 30d for lookback-only or end-anchored window; invalid -> invalid_param; ignored when both start_date and end_date set

fields.name: granularity
fields.enum_note: l2 only: day (default); hour or minute returns unsupported_granularity; ignored for staking/btc_l2

fields.name: limit
fields.enum_note: l2 only: max series rows returned; 0 means no extra cap beyond date window; ignored for staking/btc_l2

tools.logic: Return staking, l2 or btc_l2 activity for the chosen metric_group. Preserve all declared response_fields/series_fields and project whitelist stacks|rootstock|merlin|bob|bitlayer. Staking returns validator/queue/supply/rate/APR/wait metrics with missing_fields and data_status; rows for 2025-05-07 through 2025-05-21 may include quality_warning. Windows longer than 400 days are truncated. l2 requires granularity=day; tx_count/l1_fee_usd remain unavailable. btc_l2 requires non-null tvl_usd/protocol_count/tx_count_1d for complete status, otherwise missing_required_fields. Unavailable capability returns requires_open_search. Validator estimates derived from ETH use ETH/32.

errors.when: metric_group empty, bad YYYY-MM-DD, invalid lookback, or start_date after end_date
metric_group is not staking|l2|btc_l2, or the requested activity data is unavailable
staking and chain not eth|ethereum; l2 and chain not in supported list; btc_l2 and chain not btc

tools.series_fields_note: Staking series expose eth_supply, staking_apr_7d, entry_wait_days and exit_wait_days; unavailable values are recorded in missing_fields. l2: tx_count/l1_fee_usd are not provided. btc_l2: protocol_count is int64; other values use float64/int64.
tools.description: [Read] Chain-level activity metrics (staking=Ethereum beacon, l2=daily ops, btc_l2=BTC L2 protocol ecosystem). DeFi platform context -> get_platform_info.

fields.name: mode
fields.enum_note: anything other than timeseries normalizes to latest

tools.logic: Require indicator. mode latest|timeseries defaults to latest for other values. Preserve country filters and start_time/end_time aliases start_date/end_date. Timeseries defaults to the preceding year; latest applies dates only when provided. size defaults to 20, maximum 400. Return latest.snapshots or timeseries.observations; empty timeseries may suggest latest. Unavailable data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Macro indicator latest or timeseries (CPI, rates, etc.). Calendar events -> get_economic_calendar; dashboard -> get_macro_summary.

tools.logic: Return economic calendar events for a UTC YYYY-MM-DD window. Both dates omitted means today through today+30d; start only means start through start+30d; end only means today through end. Reject end before start. Empty/all event_type means no type filter; importance is applied when available. size defaults to 20, maximum 400. Sort by event_date descending. Unavailable data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Economic calendar events. Single indicator series -> get_macro_indicator.

tools.logic: Return a zero-argument macro dashboard for federal_funds_rate, cpi_yoy, gdp_growth, unemployment_rate, nonfarm_payroll and pce_yoy, plus up to five upcoming calendar events when available. Unavailable required macro data returns not_implemented; unavailable capability returns requires_open_search.
tools.description: [Read] Macro dashboard summary (no inputs). Indicator detail -> get_macro_indicator.

fields.name: market_type
fields.enum_note: omit -> spot

tools.logic: Require symbol. market_type accepts spot|futures|delivery|options, default spot. depth defaults to 20, maximum 100; derivative settlement defaults to usdt. Pass extra options through to the market-data request. Preserve cex_tool provenance. Upstream market-data errors return empty items; unavailable capability returns public_mcp_not_configured.
tools.description: [Read] Live Gate order book for a symbol (spot/futures/etc.). Aggregated CEX depth -> platformmetrics get_cex_orderbook_depth.

fields.name: market_type
fields.enum_note: omit -> spot

tools.logic: Require symbol and return recent trades for market_type, default spot. limit defaults to 50, subject to the service maximum; derivative settlement uses settle. tools.logic: Require symbol and timeframe. Without start/end return the latest candles, default limit 100 subject to the service maximum, newest first. With a range, pass Unix-second bounds through. extra may override interval; an unparseable timeframe uses 60 seconds. Market-data errors return empty items; unavailable capability returns public_mcp_not_configured.
